workload.note: Rushing yards only; total TD combines rush+rec.
2,005 rush yds; NFL rushing leader; AP Offensive Player of the Year, First-team All-Pro; career-high 345 carries.
Rush yards led NFL per Eagles RB preview (philadelphiaeagles.com, 2026-07-07); carry count down ~65 from 2024 peak.

contract.note: 2-year, $41.2M extension signed March 2025 (through 2028), $36M guaranteed at signing plus up to $15M more in incentives; $20.6M AAV made him first $20M+/yr RB in NFL history. Prior deal was 3-yr/$37.75M ($12.6M APY) signed 2024 offseason.

scheme.note: Eagles fired OC Kevin Patullo 2026-01-13 (HC Nick Sirianni: 'Ultimately, when we fall short of our goals that responsibility lies on my shoulders'); offense had finished 24th overall / 19th in points in 2025. Hired Sean Mannion (age 33, ex-Packers QB coach 2025, offensive assistant 2024) as new OC, 2026-01-30 — first-time NFL playcaller. Barkley on new system (2026-07-31): 'I think it's pretty cool that you start from scratch, learn a new language, get familiar with a new system' and on running-style tweak: 'The thing that changes for me, you coach it a little bit different...getting more of a one-cut mentality.'
